title: Frasier Crane si nevidí do pusy (S02E06)
plot: Frasier urazí posluchače své show poznámkou o počasí v Seattlu.(SkyShowtime)

reviews.author: PunisherEDNA
reviews.text: Frasier v rádiu omylem urazí celé město Seattle. Celý díl se nese v duchu jeho marné snahy o nápravu, která vše jen zhoršuje.(17.01.2026)

reviews.author: Loki_Six
reviews.text: "Let me tell you something: a city's like a woman. You get one mad at you, it doesn't matter if you're completely right and she's completely wrong, you'll apologize anyway, or you'll be paying for it for the rest of your life."(23.08.2024)
